name: T&L Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating out of South Korea, T&L Co., Ltd. specializes in developing and marketing a variety of medical and polymer-based materials. The company's diverse product portfolio features chemical compounds like water-borne resins, hardeners, functional additives, and urethane foam. It also provides a wide array of wound care items, including hydrocolloid, foam, hydrogel, silicone, and alginate dressings. Additionally, T&L manufactures orthopedic goods such as casts and splints. The firm was established in 1998 and maintains its headquarters in Yongin-si, South Korea.
